 G ainbridge Fieldhouse is preparing for one of the most attractive matchups at the start of the NBA season. The Indiana Pacers host the Philadelphia 76ers in an Eastern Conference clash that pits two playoff-ambitious projects against each other, but on very different paths in these opening weeks.
 As Philadelphia settles in among the teams leading the East, Indiana looks to straighten out an uneven start in front of its home crowd. Here’s everything you need to know: tip-off time, where to watch it, and the keys to the game.
 LeBron James’ handshake with Dean Wade stands out from his other teammate routines Where to watch the 76ers vs Pacers and start time
 The matchup will be played this Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, a venue with a capacity of 17,274 fans. The start time of LeBron James' game with the 76ers will be:
 Eastern Time: 7:00 p.m.
 Central Time: 6:00 p.m.
 Pacific Time: 4:00 p.m
 As for the broadcast in the United States, the game will have national coverage on ESPN; in addition, fans will be able to stream it via YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, Fubo, DIRECTV, and Sling TV. 
 Standings overview for Philadelphia and Indiana
 The picture in the Eastern Conference highlights contrasts. Philadelphia arrives in Indianapolis as the East's second seed , with a record of 3 wins and 1 loss (.750) that also puts them atop the Atlantic Division.
 By virtue of points accumulated —440 scored to 428 allowed— it is a team that punishes on offense and has known how to take care of its opening commitments. 
 Indiana, meanwhile, sits in the middle of the standings. The Pacers are in ninth place in the East with 2 wins and 2 losses (.500), an identical record in the Central Division, where they are third behind the Detroit Pistons and Cleveland Cavaliers.
 Their +6 differential (466 scored, 460 allowed) reflects close games and a fast pace: Indiana is one of the teams that generates the most possessions, a hallmark that could tip the balance if it manages to impose its tempo.
 The players to watch in the 76ers vs Pacers
 The box office is headed by the Pacers' franchise point guard, Tyrese Haliburton, the floor general who sets Indiana's frenetic pace through his playmaking . Around him, Pascal Siakam's interior presence and versatility provide the points and rebounds a team that lives to run needs.
 The arrival of Croatian Ivica Zubac gives Indiana a strong defensive and rebounding anchor, while pieces like Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard and the experienced T.J. McConnell round out a deep and combative rotation.
 Across from them, Philadelphia boasts one of the most eye-catching rosters in the league. Joel Embiid remains the dominant focal point in the post, with the ability to punish any interior defense.
 Alongside him, guard Tyrese Maxey brings explosiveness and scoring from the perimeter , and the talent multiplies with the presence of two heavyweights like LeBron James and Jaylen Brown, who raise the Sixers' competitive ceiling. Veteran Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and young VJ Edgecombe round out a backcourt with shooting and energy.
 What is the prediction for Pacers vs 76ers?
 Philadelphia comes in with a better record, greater individual pedigree, and the confidence of sitting second in the East; without a doubt, the Sixers start as favorites. However, home-court advantage at Gainbridge Fieldhouse and the breakneck pace imposed by Haliburton could level the contest and turn it into a high-scoring duel decided in the final minutes.
 The forecast points to a tight, offense-driven game, with a slight edge for Philadelphia if Embiid and Maxey maintain their level; but it wouldn’t be surprising if Indiana, at home and at full speed, pulls off the upset. A head-to-head matchup well worth not missing.
